samples.identification: KernelYK dropper with Gh0st-derived safemon RAT
evidence: Outer WinMain at VA 0xff1c30 enumerates VM guest processes and branches to an exit path on matches. It stages embedded native driver and user-mode images and launches rundll32 with a payload export.

Embedded driver at outer offset 0xdc50 resolves NtQueryDirectoryFile through the native image and SSDT at VA 0x1151a. Its directory-result wrapper compacts selected records out of the returned linked buffer at VA 0x134bd.
Driver real-mode code at its file offset 0x6c0c saves and replaces BIOS INT 13h vector. Read interceptor patches loaded code with operand-size-prefixed far CALL at 0x6cfe.

Embedded safemon DLL at outer offset 0x169d8 polls GetAsyncKeyState at VA 0x1000e366, records window titles and key labels, calls logger 0x1000e050, XORs recorded text by 0x62 at 0x1000e133 and passes output to an indirect file write.
Clipboard acquisition code at DLL file offset 0xfe5d resolves GetClipboardData(CF_TEXT), locks its result and copies text to an allocated tagged record.
Generic stack-byte stores at DLL file offset 0xded2 construct registry type labels, not exploit shellcode.
Outer VA 0xff21b1 calls imported NetUserDel for local temporary-account cleanup. This is recorded as a neutral API capability, not destruction.

samples.identification: StormAttack injector with erased resources and mismatched Authenticode digest
evidence: CRT entry 0x402674 calls program entry 0x401cb0 at 0x4027a3.

Config dword at RVA 0x4120 is 3, selecting Active Setup installation. VA 0x401900 builds a destination executable path, creates an Installed Components subkey, writes StubPath at 0x401a4b, reads its current image and writes a patched copy at 0x401b26; caller then runs self-delete code.

VA 0x401260 contains LanmanServer ServiceDLL delete/write operations. VA 0x401150 creates a child, allocates/writes its DLL path remotely, resolves LoadLibraryA, passes that export to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
VA 0x401390 constructs COMSPEC /c del of current module short path and executes it via CreateProcessA.
All 40960 resource-section bytes are zero. Resource extraction code remains, but a usable resource DLL and successful DLL installation are not established.

Microsoft signer cryptography verifies over a certificate-carried digest that does not match these image bytes. This is not a valid Microsoft signature on this executable. No ransomware behavior was found.

samples.identification: Unsigned StormAttack injector with erased resources
evidence: Executable .text, .data and zeroed .rsrc are byte-identical to sample 7437705b33fe. Same CRT-to-entry path, Active Setup self-copy, LanmanServer hijack, remote LoadLibrary thread and COMSPEC cleanup code.
Only 28 .rdata bytes differ between the mapped sections; no certificate record is present. Resource section is entirely zero. No ransomware behavior was found.
